name: EH3D-PHOENIX-LASER
notes: EH3D-PHOENIX-LASER is the laser engraving program of the PHOENIX family (bright red phoenix), formerly EH3D-LASER-CAM. Scaffolding v0.0.3: a library and a command line that read a PNG or PGM image, turn it into dots (threshold, Floyd-Steinberg or Atkinson dithering) and write the G-code of a laser that burns line by line with M4 dynamic power, S0 while it travels, an overscan worked out from the acceleration and alternating directions, plus a power-against-feed calibration grid. It also reads SVG and DXF drawings and writes the G-code that cuts their contours (inside ones first, the width of the beam taken into account, tabs, several passes) and engraves their shapes with lines, with the settings of each layer in a file and the program checked line by line before it is given. A window (egui, built with the gui feature: open a picture or a drawing, see the passes of the laser, edit the table of layers, export) is written and its logic is tested, but it has not been looked at on a screen; nothing has been tried on a laser.
